extracted.intended_audience: early-career stand-up comedians submitting to Just For Laughs New Faces and similar industry showcases
extracted.subtask_description: Choosing and trimming material to make a single, representative 6-minute submission set (video) for Just For Laughs New Faces or similar industry showcases. Focuses on what to include so the set both follows submission rules and distills who you are as a comedian.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: "Please submit a recent 6-minute set (ideally something from the past 12 months). Note: Do not submit an edited reel, or 'best of' collection. We are looking for one continuous 6-minute, uninterrupted set."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the stated specs exactly: a single continuous 6-minute uninterrupted performance, ideally performed/recorded within the past year. Do not splice together a montage or a 'best of' — submit the raw continuous set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audition flexibility / contingency
rubrics_metrics.description: "Note that comedians will be free to perform other material at the audition if they so choose."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand that the submitted 6-minute video is to evaluate you for selection, but you may perform different material live at the audition. Use the submission to get you noticed, not necessarily to lock you into only those jokes later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authenticity / be unabashedly yourself
rubrics_metrics.description: "You’ll never go wrong by being unabashedly yourself. Do whatever is your truest identity."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose material that reflects your real voice, perspective, and identity. Authenticity is emphasized over trying to mimic trends or other performers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representativeness / distillation of self
rubrics_metrics.description: Ask: "what’s the best distillation of me?" — select material that best captures who you are as a performer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pick six minutes that act as a clear, compact representation of your comedic persona and strengths. The goal is to communicate 'this is who I am' to selectors in a short window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / avoid generic takes
rubrics_metrics.description: If you do common topical jokes (e.g., dating apps), ensure they stand out: "If you’re going to do a joke about Hinge, it better be the best joke about Hinge I’ve ever heard."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid obvious or overused angles on ubiquitous topics unless you have an unusually fresh, distinctive take. The selector pool is deep, so familiar subjects require exceptional execution to rise above.

rubrics_metrics.name: Showcase what only you can tell
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider whether material is uniquely yours: "Is it the jokes only I can tell?"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer material tied to your unique perspective, background, or experiences — things that would feel different if told by someone else. These bits help differentiate you in a crowded field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn from successful examples / common themes
rubrics_metrics.description: Studying other selected sets revealed recurring themes: "Lots of people talking about their family... where they're from... their sexuality... dating."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Watch past accepted sets to learn patterns and what reads well on industry showcases. Note themes that commonly appear, but don't copy—use observations to inform what kind of personal material tends to translate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Condensing longer material into six minutes
rubrics_metrics.description: The author lists typical hour-show sections (intro/travel, about me, local material, politics, public school, arrest story) and asks how to distill that to six minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify your top signature bits or a single, strong narrative you can compress into six minutes. Instead of trying to cram many small jokes, choose the clearest, most impactful threads from your longer set that best represent your style and range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Realistic competitiveness / aim for high polish
rubrics_metrics.description: "There are a LOT of funny people in the world and only a handful of them get selected for Just For Laughs."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of the high competition and aim to submit highly polished material. Tighten edits, timing, and performance so your six minutes are as strong as possible; marginal submissions are unlikely to succeed.
